description: This Java source file defines the MainFragment class for the AnySoftKeyboard Android application. It manages the main settings UI, including backup and restore preferences, handling permissions, and navigation within the app.

classes.name: MainFragment
classes.description: MainFragment manages the main settings UI of the AnySoftKeyboard app, including backup/restore, navigation, permissions, and UI updates.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the main_fragment layout for the fragment.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Initializes views, sets up dialogs, and configures UI elements after the view is created.

methods.name: onCreateOptionsMenu
methods.description: Inflates the options menu for the fragment.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles menu item selections for navigation and backup/restore actions.

methods.name: onViewStateRestored
methods.description: Sets up clickable links and animations after the view state is restored.

methods.name: onStart
methods.description: Prepares the UI, checks if the keyboard is set as default, and initializes demo keyboard view.

methods.name: setNotificationPermissionCardVisibility
methods.description: Checks and updates the visibility of notification permission request UI.

methods.name: onDemoViewBitmapReady
methods.description: Analyzes the demo keyboard bitmap to extract dominant colors and update UI accordingly.

methods.name: onStop
methods.description: Disposes of palette disposable to prevent memory leaks.

methods.name: onDestroyView
methods.description: Cleans up views and dialogs when the view is destroyed.

methods.name: onSetupDialogRequired
methods.description: Configures dialogs for backup/restore success or failure messages.

methods.name: onBackupRestoreDialogRequired
methods.description: Prepares dialogs for selecting backup or restore providers and files.

methods.name: launchBackupRestore
methods.description: Performs backup or restore operation asynchronously with progress dialog.

methods.name: onActivityResult
methods.description: Handles results from file picker for backup or restore.

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Disposes of disposables to prevent memory leaks.
